Acrobatics / Resist Trip (DEX)
Axe Basics: +1 gear with this trip-defense skill check while holding a readied axe; gear bonuses do not stack (pp.176,179–180,329). Resist Trip: opposed Acrobatics(DEX), Armor Check Penalty; action error modifier+1; larger participant +4 per Size category (pp.352,361). Your Size bonus +0. The GC resolves the opposed result, sprawled/flat-footed conditions, critical effects, final attacks and permitted counter-Trip sequence separately. Opposed response. Active. Armor Check Penalty. Rules p.361.
